lecture_05.anchor_convention: lecture_05.pdf:p<page>, page numbers from `pdftotext -layout` form feeds (title slide = p1)
lecture_05.note: Evidence is the text layer of the slides (lecture_05.txt), extracted page-by-page by discover_slides.py.
